SpreadsheetMaps.ErrorMessage: Spreadsheet must contain the Quarterly Return Template tab. The Quarterly Return Template tab is missing from your file or has been renamed. Action required: Open your spreadsheet and make sure the Quarterly Return Template tab is present. It must follow the naming format exactly with no spelling mistakes or additional spaces.

DataColumns.ErrorMessage: Column A in the Quarterly Return Template tab must be empty. There is at least one letter or number in at least one box in column A. Action required: Clear all data from column A, save the file then submit it again.

Column B in the the Quarterly Return Template tab cannot be empty. There is no data in any of the boxes in column B. Action required: Make sure the row names in the file match those that are in the template, save the file then submit it again.

SpreadsheetMaps.ErrorMessage: Spreadsheet must contain the Cover tab. The Cover tab is missing from your file or has been renamed. Action required: Open your spreadsheet and make sure the Cover tab is present. It must follow the naming format exactly with no spelling mistakes or additional spaces.

Rules.ErrorMessage: Date range in cell B5 in the Quarterly Return Template tab can only cover one year. The date range in the cell is too long or short. Action required: Edit the spreadsheet so the date in the cell follows the required format, like 2026-27 Quarterly Data.

Local authority codes must match. The codes you have given for the local authority you are submitting data for do not match. Action required: Check and correct the local authority you have selected in this service and named in cell B13 in the Cover page of the spreadsheet.
